The Head of Service Delivery (HoSD) is responsible for the full Ericsson CSS portfolio Service Delivery (or specific segments, depending on key account scope). The role is accountable for driving service delivery, service excellence, operational governance, and financial performance across designated key customers or regions.
  
  
As the shadow P&L owner for the business area and delegate of the CSS Client Business Executive, the HoSD ensures seamless program execution, portfolio management, customer satisfaction & relationship, and long-term business growth.
  
  
This role is pivotal in leading delivery governance, orchestrating the delivery engine, resolving escalations, and supporting pre-sales while ensuring profitability and customer value realization.

* Overall accountable for the Service Delivery and profitability of the CSS business for assigned customers or countries.
* Act as the primary customer interface, working closely with Key Account Managers (KAMs) and/or Head of Sales and/or Client Executive Partner on governance, strategy, and escalations.

* Align with relevant Domain Sales Managers on overall presales activities, ensuring an e2e consistent view from solution design to delivery.
* Lead cross-functional, matrix teams exemplifying Ericsson Leadership Principles
* Develop strategies to identify and capture add on sales and upselling opportunities across portfolio.
* Act as CFR (Customer Fulfilment Responsible) for the assigned accounts.
* Ensure risk, compliance, and quality management standards are maintained across all engagements.
* Drive innovation and digital transformation (automation, AI, emerging technologies) to enhance service delivery.
* Manage vendors and third parties (i.e. ASPs/ARPs)
* Coaching and mentoring internal delivery teams.

**What You Will Bring**

* University degree in Engineering/ICT, Higher university such as an MBA considered a merit
* 10-15 years of experience in senior, customer-facing roles and relationship management across all customer levels including C-level
* At least 8 years in program or project management
* Presales and service delivery experience with accountability for end-to-end programs.
* Strong leadership skills in multi-cultural, multi-geography environment
* Proven ability to generate add-on sales in complex projects
* Strong business acumen, financial understanding, and P&L management skills
* PMP and Project Management Certifications considered a plus
* Deep knowledge of Ericsson’s CSS Portfolio and experience with mission-critical/safety business delivery
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Stakeholder management internally and within customer organization
* Experience in handling escalations with customers
* Growth Mindset

**Additional Information**

* This role may be subject to security clearance depending on customer and contract requirements.
* Health, safety, and well-being are core responsibilities for all employees and leaders, supporting a safe and thriving workplace in line with Ericsson’s Target Zero commitments

You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

Title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Global Submarine Networks Landing Stations Build
Description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Reston, VA, USA; New York, NY, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program management.
* 8 years of experience in engineering design, technical program management, or infrastructure delivery focused on Cable Landing Stations (CLS), hyperscale data centers, or telecommunications facilities.
* 5 years of experience in leadership role with/without direct reports.
* 5 years of experience with submarine cable system landing infrastructure, including experience with beach manholes (BMH), terrestrial front-haul duct routes, Ocean Ground Bed (OGB) earthing systems, and Power Feed Equipment (PFE) room requirements.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Infrastructure Management, accompanied by an active Professional Engineer (PE), Chartered Engineer (CEng), or equivalent international engineering licensure.
* Experience in bidding, designing, operating, and commissioning of mission critical systems.
* Expertise navigating coastal zoning, nearshore geophysical hazards, seismicity, flood resilience, environmental impact assessments (EIA), and marine permit constraints impacting landing station design.
* Strong background in technical due diligence, utility infrastructure assessments, vendor contract negotiations, and managing multi-million-dollar capital expenditure budgets (CapEx) alongside operating budgets (OpEx).

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Direct, mentor, and grow a multi-disciplinary team of global engineering SMEs and technical program managers responsible for land due diligence, facility engineering, and construction delivery.
* Establish and manage design frameworks, quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) protocols, stage gate project execution procedures, and programmatic delivery standards for Cable Landing Stations globally.
* Manage portfolio of technical due diligence evaluations on greenfield land parcels and existing facility assets worldwide, evaluating civil, geotechnical, environmental, power, and marine approach suitability for new landing stations.
* Evaluate design delivery models in conjunction with construction execution and contracting methodologies to derisk project delivery and accelerate portfolio execution while maintaining design quality assurance.
* Lead teams responsible for technical field administration during construction execution, including managing Requests for Information (RFIs), submittal reviews, design field changes, and construction quality inspections.

Title: Director, IT Infrastructure & Operations
Description:
**Ready to shape the future of IT across a growing North American organization, all while working remotely from Canada?**
At Ramudden Global North America, we help make roads and communities safer through traffic management, safety infrastructure, and urban mobility solutions. As part of Ramudden Global, we're connected to more than 5,000 employees across 14 countries, bringing together local expertise and global capabilities to make a difference in the communities we serve.
  
  
As our North American business continues to grow, technology plays an increasingly important role in how we operate, connect our teams, and support our customers. We're looking for an experienced IT leader who enjoys building strong teams, driving innovation, and turning technology challenges into business opportunities.
  
  
This is an opportunity to take ownership of our regional IT infrastructure and operations, influence technology strategy, strengthen cybersecurity, and lead initiatives that will support our continued growth.
  
  
**The Opportunity: Director, IT Infrastructure & Operations**
Reporting to the Vice President, Information Technology, the Director will lead the strategy, performance, and ongoing development of IT infrastructure and operations across Ramudden Global North America.
  
  
You'll oversee cloud platforms, networking, cybersecurity, and IT service delivery while driving modernization, standardization, and technology integration across our operating companies. Working closely with senior leaders, operational teams, and Global IT, you'll help build a secure, reliable, and scalable technology environment that supports our business today and prepares us for what's ahead.
  
  
We're looking for someone who can balance strategic thinking with practical execution, enjoys solving complex challenges, and knows how to bring people together to get things done.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**IT Strategy & Infrastructure**

* Develop and lead the North American IT infrastructure and cloud strategy, ensuring alignment with business priorities and global IT standards.
* Oversee Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, enterprise networking, and infrastructure services.
* Drive technology modernization, standardization, and consolidation across operating companies.
* Ensure reliable, secure, and scalable technology services across offices, branches, yards, and operational locations.

**Cybersecurity & Business Continuity**

* Lead regional cybersecurity operations in partnership with Global IT and cybersecurity teams.
* Oversee identity and endpoint security, vulnerability management, security monitoring, and incident response.
* Identify and manage technology risks while supporting security compliance and audit requirements.
* Lead disaster recovery and business continuity planning, ensuring backup and recovery capabilities are regularly tested.

**IT Operations & Service Delivery**

* Oversee regional IT operations and service delivery, ensuring employees receive reliable and responsive support.
* Establish clear service standards, performance measures, escalation processes, and accountability.
* Drive automation, process improvements, and standardization to improve service quality and operational efficiency.
* Manage technology vendors, managed service providers, and strategic partnerships.

**Technology Integration & Financial Management**

* Lead infrastructure assessments and technology integration activities related to acquisitions.
* Oversee regional modernization and transformation initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
* Develop and manage regional IT budgets, forecasts, and technology investments.
* Identify opportunities to optimize technology spending, reduce technical debt, and improve overall value.

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing regional IT team.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities, and performance expectations.
* Develop internal technical capabilities and encourage accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Work closely with senior leadership and Global IT to represent North American business needs and priorities.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT, infrastructure, cloud, or technology operations, including at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, geographically distributed IT environments.
* Strong technical knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Active Directory, and enterprise networking.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity, Zero Trust, IT risk management, disaster recovery, and IT service management.
* Experience leading infrastructure modernization, cloud adoption, technology transformation, and integration initiatives.
* Experience managing IT budgets, vendors, managed service providers, and strategic technology investments.
* Proven ability to build and develop technical teams, manage change, and drive operational improvements.
* Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams and executive leadership.
* Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, and technology integrations is considered an asset.

Relevant Microsoft, ITIL, cybersecurity, or networking certifications are considered an asset. Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
  
  
At Ramudden Global North America, we value collaboration, accountability, and people who take pride in making a difference. You'll have the opportunity to work with teams across North America and around the world, influence our technology direction, and help build the foundation for our continued growth.

Title: Cloud Infrastructure Manager
Description:
Cloud Infrastructure Manager
  
**The role**

Lead the cloud infrastructure that runs myZoi’s production platforms across AWS and Azure, keeping them reliable, secure, scalable and cost-effective.

This is a player-coach role. You will manage the DevOps and SRE team while staying hands-on in design, implementation and incident response, with particular depth in cloud and infrastructure networking.

You will own the infrastructure roadmap, operational performance and delivery of improvements. You will work closely with Architecture, Engineering, Cybersecurity and Technology Operations to support business growth and maintain service continuity.

Key responsibilities
  
  
Team leadership
  
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop the DevOps and SRE team; set clear objectives and manage performance.
* Plan priorities across operational work, improvements and projects, with clear owners, milestones and escalation of risks.
* Build on-call arrangements, backup coverage and knowledge sharing so no service depends on a single engineer; take part in the escalation rota.
* Report proactively on service health, delivery progress, costs and material risks.

Hands-on infrastructure and networking
  
  
  

* Design, build and operate cloud networking across AWS and Azure, including VPC/VNet design, hub-and-spoke or transit topologies, routing, DNS, load balancing, private endpoints and hybrid connectivity (VPN, AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute).
* Implement network security controls, including segmentation, firewalls, security groups and NSGs, WAF and secure ingress and egress.
* Build and operate compute, storage, managed databases and Kubernetes platforms, with clear segregation of production and non-production environments.
* Write and review Terraform, and set standards for configuration management, patching and lifecycle management using version control, peer review and automated checks.
* Develop infrastructure designs with Architecture and implement the agreed standards.
* Lead the technical planning and execution of migrations and infrastructure transitions, including testing, cutover, rollback and handover.

DevOps and reliability
  
  
  

* Oversee infrastructure automation, deployment tooling and CI/CD in partnership with Engineering.
* Improve monitoring, observability and actionable alerting; agree service-level objectives with service owners.
* Own infrastructure-level escalation and restoration during incidents, then drive root-cause analysis and lasting fixes.
* Maintain capacity and performance plans aligned with expected demand.

Backup and disaster recovery
  
  
  

* Own infrastructure backup, restore and recovery mechanisms.
* Plan and run recovery tests with Technology Operations and application owners, validating agreed RTO and RPO targets.

Security and compliance
  
  
  

* Implement cloud security controls in line with Cybersecurity policies, including identity and privileged access, encryption, logging and secrets management.
* Ensure vulnerabilities and configuration weaknesses are remediated within agreed timelines.
* Apply regulatory, data-residency and contractual requirements to infrastructure, with guidance from the responsible functions.
* Maintain current infrastructure documentation, recovery procedures and auditable records of access, changes, control operation and test results; support internal and external reviews.

Cost and supplier management
  
  
  

* Manage cloud spend within approved budgets, with transparent allocation, forecasting and reporting.
* Drive cost optimisation through rightsizing, commitment-based purchasing and removal of unused resources.
* Manage the technical performance of cloud and infrastructure suppliers, supporting commercial decisions with Finance and Procurement.

Experience and capabilities
  

* Typically 8 or more years in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps or related disciplines, including at least 3 years managing engineers.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams that run business-critical production services, while remaining hands-on.
* Strong hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure. Experience with cross-cloud migration is advantageous.
* Deep networking expertise across cloud and hybrid environments: TCP/IP, routing, subnetting, DNS, load balancing, VPN and private connectivity, firewalls and segmentation, and troubleshooting complex connectivity issues.
* Practical expertise in identity and access management, Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD and observability.
* Experience with disaster recovery testing, major incidents, infrastructure security and cost optimisation.
* Ability to challenge technical proposals, prioritise competing demands and explain decisions in clear business terms.
* Proven delivery through internal teams and external suppliers, with effective delegation and proactive escalation.
* Financial-services, payments or other regulated-sector experience is preferred.

Qualifications
  

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Relevant AWS, Azure, Terraform or Kubernetes certifications are desirable.
* Networking certifications (for example AWS Advanced Networking, Azure Network Engineer Associate or CCNP) are a plus.
* Familiarity with ITIL and recognised security frameworks is advantageous.

Title: Manager, Cloud & Platform Engineering – Banking (36293)
Description:
Manager, Cloud & Platform Engineering – Banking
  
  
**Location:**
Toronto, Ontario – Hybrid (1–2 days per week onsite)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Permanent, Full-Time
  
  
**Compensation:**
Salary plus Variable Bonus
  
  
**Benefits:**
Comprehensive Benefits, RRSP Matching and up to 35 Days of Paid Time Off (PTO)
  
  
**Start Date:**
ASAP
  
  
**Travel:**
Client visits as required, primarily within the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), with occasional travel for industry events and conferences.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
Our client is seeking a Manager, Cloud & Platform Engineering to join its Technology Advisory practice, with a dedicated focus on the banking and financial services sector.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong cloud and platform engineering knowledge, banking industry experience, people leadership and client-facing consulting capabilities to lead technology engagements within complex enterprise banking environments.
  
  
This position bridges technology strategy, solution architecture, programme delivery, people management and commercial opportunity development across cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity and application modernization.
  
  
This is neither a primarily hands-on engineering or architecture role nor a pure sales position. The successful candidate must possess the technical credibility to assess and challenge enterprise cloud solutions, lead technical teams, engage with senior client stakeholders and translate business requirements into practical, executable technology programmes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Technology Advisory & Client Engagement
  
  

* Lead strategic and technical discussions across cloud transformation, platform engineering, data, AI, cybersecurity and application modernization.
* Translate banking business priorities, regulatory requirements and operational challenges into practical technology strategies and executable programmes.
* Provide technical and architecture-level guidance across Microsoft Azure, AWS and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Lead client workshops, architecture reviews, technology roadmaps, proposals and strategic presentations.
* Assess complex enterprise technology environments, identify risks and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Establish and maintain trusted relationships with banking clients, senior executives, architects, engineers and other stakeholders.
* Remain actively involved throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes, maintain client confidence and identify emerging technology priorities.

Programme Delivery & Platform Engineering
  
  

* Lead cloud transformation, platform engineering and technology modernization engagements within banking environments.
* Shape engagements from discovery and solution design through proposal development, mobilization and delivery.
* Provide direction on enterprise cloud platforms, shared cloud services and modern application delivery practices.
* Collaborate with architects, engineers, consultants and delivery teams to ensure solutions align with business, technical, security and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee day-to-day team activities, delivery priorities and engagement performance.

People Leadership & Team Development
  
  

* Lead, mentor and develop multidisciplinary teams of architects, consultants and engineers.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance feedback sessions and professional development discussions.
* Coach and enable technical team members to achieve individual, team and client objectives.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing team environment.
* Provide clear direction to technical teams while effectively communicating with business and executive stakeholders.
* Demonstrate the ability to influence and lead across teams, including situations without direct reporting authority.

Pre-Sales & Account Development
  
  

* Support pre-sales activities, client discovery sessions, solution development and proposal preparation.
* Partner with sales, delivery and practice leadership to identify account growth opportunities.
* Contribute to expanding initial client engagements into broader technology programmes and long-term relationships.
* Participate in the commercial and technical aspects of the sales cycle.

This position supports business development and account growth but does not require independently prospecting for or generating new business.
  
  
**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* Approximately 7+ years of progressive experience across banking technology, cloud computing, platform engineering, technology consulting, architecture or technology leadership.
* Demonstrated experience working within enterprise banking environments, either directly for a financial institution or through advisory and consulting engagements.
* Strong understanding of banking technology governance, risk, compliance, regulatory requirements and technology investment decision-making.
* Experience in one or more banking domains, including retail banking, commercial banking, payments, lending, wealth management, capital markets, risk or finance.
* Proven experience leading technical or multidisciplinary teams, including coaching, mentoring, performance feedback and day-to-day team management.
* Demonstrated ability to assess complex technology environments and provide clear, practical technical and strategic direction.
* Broad understanding of cloud computing, data, AI, cybersecurity, systems integration and application modernization.
* Strong client-facing consulting, communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Professional and credible executive presence, with the ability to communicate effectively with both senior business leaders and technical teams.

Technical Knowledge & Expertise
  
  
Although this is not primarily a hands-on engineering or architecture position, candidates must possess sufficient technical depth to assess, shape and challenge enterprise cloud solutions within large banking environments.
  
  
**Experience And Knowledge Should Include**

* Cloud Platforms: Microsoft Azure (preferred), Amazon Web Services (AWS) and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Cloud Architecture: Enterprise cloud architecture, hybrid cloud and multi-cloud environments.
* Platform Engineering: Enterprise platform engineering and shared cloud services supporting multiple teams and applications.
* Cloud Governance: Cloud governance frameworks, landing zones, security, regulatory compliance and operational controls.
* Identity & Networking: Identity and Access Management (IAM), cloud networking and network access controls.
* Cloud Operations: Resilience, reliability and observability.
* Containerization & Orchestration: Kubernetes and Docker.
* Infrastructure Automation: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated infrastructure provisioning.
* DevOps & Application Delivery: CI/CD pipelines, APIs, systems integration and modern application delivery practices.

Candidates must be comfortable evaluating technical approaches, identifying risks and communicating recommendations to architects, engineers, business stakeholders and executives.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience within a technology consulting, professional services, systems integration or technology services organization.
* Experience supporting major Canadian banking or financial services clients.
* Experience leading significant cloud transformation, platform modernization or enterprise technology programmes.
* Experience contributing to pre-sales, account growth, business development or market development initiatives.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary technical and consulting teams.
* Strong familiarity with Microsoft Azure within complex, regulated enterprise environments.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Building trusted relationships with banking clients and internal stakeholders.
* Providing credible technical and strategic guidance across complex cloud and platform engineering initiatives.
* Leading and developing high-performing technical teams.
* Consistently delivering high-quality client outcomes.
* Identifying opportunities to expand existing engagements and strengthen long-term client relationships.
* Demonstrating integrity, respect, collaboration and professionalism.
* Maintaining a commitment to continuous learning, innovation and professional development.

Title: Incident Manager
Description:
Koniag IT Systems, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an Incident Manager to support KITS and our government customer Washington, DC. The position is hybrid, requires 3 days onsite. This position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a Public Trust.
  
Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.
  
Koniag IT Systems, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an experienced Incident Manager to support a comprehensive enterprise IT operations and support engagement for a federal customer. This role serves as the primary owner of the enterprise incident management lifecycle, ensuring rapid detection, triage, escalation, resolution, and post-incident review of IT incidents across a geographically distributed, 24x7 hybrid on-premises and cloud environment spanning AWS commercial and GovCloud, Microsoft 365, Azure Government, and enterprise network and application platforms.
  
  
The Incident Manager operates within a mature ITIL 4-aligned IT Service Management (ITSM) practice and works in close coordination with the enterprise NOC, multi-tier Service Desk, network engineering, infrastructure, and platform operations teams to ensure that all incidents are managed to resolution within established service level objectives. This individual plays a central role in driving service restoration, minimizing business impact, and contributing to the program's continual service improvement objectives through trend analysis, problem identification, and post-incident learning activities.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented and operationally experienced ITSM professional with a strong background in enterprise incident management, ITIL-based service management practices, and federal IT operations environments. This individual must thrive in a fast-paced, high-accountability 24x7 operational setting and possess the ability to coordinate effectively across diverse technical teams and Government stakeholders under time-critical conditions.
  
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain an SBA background investigation, HSPD-12 PIV credentials, and applicable IT access authorizations prior to performing work. This position may be primarily performed at SBA Headquarters and/or approved remote/telework locations.
  
  
The Incident Manager is responsible for owning and managing the end-to-end enterprise incident management lifecycle in accordance with ITIL 4 best practices and SBA OCIO service management requirements. This individual ensures that all incidents—from Tier 1 Service Desk tickets through Priority 1 critical enterprise outages—are accurately classified, prioritized, assigned, escalated, and resolved within established service level agreements (SLAs). The Incident Manager serves as the central coordination hub during major incidents, driving technical bridge calls, managing stakeholder communications, and ensuring timely service restoration. This role also contributes to problem management, change management support, knowledge management, and continual service improvement activities.
  
  
Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:
  
  
**Incident Lifecycle Management:**  

* Own and manage the full enterprise incident management lifecycle from initial detection and logging through triage, categorization, prioritization, assignment, escalation, resolution, and formal closure in the Government's ITSM platform.
* Ensure all incidents are accurately classified by priority (P1–P4) in accordance with established impact and urgency criteria, and that appropriate response and resolution timelines are applied and monitored in real time.
* Monitor the active incident queue continuously, identifying aging incidents, escalation triggers, SLA breach risks, and stalled assignments, and taking proactive action to ensure forward progress on all open incidents.
* Coordinate and drive the timely assignment of incidents to the appropriate Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3, or Tier 4 technical resources based on incident category, complexity, and required expertise.
* Ensure incidents are escalated promptly and appropriately—both functionally across technical teams and hierarchically to program leadership and Government stakeholders—when SLA thresholds, scope, or business impact warrant escalation.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and timely incident records in the ITSM platform throughout the incident lifecycle, ensuring all actions, decisions, workarounds, and resolutions are thoroughly documented.

**Major Incident Management:**  

* Serve as the primary coordinator and decision-maker for all Priority 1 (P1) and Priority 2 (P2) major incidents, activating and leading technical bridge calls, war rooms, and cross-functional response teams to drive rapid service restoration.
* Ensure P1 critical incidents are acknowledged within 15 minutes and that service restoration is achieved within 4 hours in accordance with program service level objectives, meeting the Government's target of at least 90% of P1 incidents restored within the 4-hour SLA.
* Maintain clear, accurate, and timely stakeholder communications throughout major incident events, including initial notifications, status updates at defined intervals, and formal incident closure notifications to the COR and Government stakeholders.
* Coordinate with the NOC, Service Desk Manager, technical leads, and program leadership to ensure all required resources are engaged, barriers to resolution are removed, and escalation paths are followed during major incidents.
* Lead or facilitate formal post-incident reviews (PIRs) for all P1 and significant P2 incidents, ensuring root cause analysis findings, contributing factors, corrective actions, and lessons learned are thoroughly documented and tracked to completion.

**Problem Management Coordination:**  

* Collaborate with the Problem Manager or Service Management Lead to ensure incidents exhibiting patterns of recurrence or systemic root causes are formally transitioned into the problem management process.
* Contribute incident trend data, recurring issue patterns, and workaround documentation to support problem record creation, root cause investigation, and known error documentation.
* Track and monitor the implementation of permanent fixes and corrective actions arising from problem management activities, ensuring incident recurrence rates are measurably reduced over time.

**Change Management Support:**  

* Coordinate with the change management process to identify incidents resulting from unauthorized changes or failed changes, ensuring accurate linkage between incident records and associated change records in the ITSM platform.
* Participate in Change Advisory Board (CAB) activities as needed, providing incident trend data and operational risk inputs to support change impact assessment and scheduling decisions.

**ITSM Platform Administration & Reporting:**  

* Administer and maintain incident management workflows, categorization schemas, assignment group structures, escalation rules, and SLA configurations within the Government's ITSM platform (ServiceNow or equivalent) to ensure accurate and efficient incident processing.
* Develop, maintain, and deliver recurring incident management performance reports and dashboards, including metrics on incident volumes, SLA compliance rates, mean time to acknowledge (MTTA), mean time to resolve (MTTR), first-contact resolution rates, escalation rates, and incident trends by category and priority.
* Contribute incident management metrics and performance data to Sprint Review Reports, Monthly Status and Performance Reports, and the service-level/ITSM metrics dashboard submitted to the Government by the 5th business day of each month.
* Analyze incident data to identify trends, high-volume categories, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities, providing actionable recommendations to program leadership and the Service Management Lead.

**Knowledge Management:**  

* Oversee the development, review, and maintenance of incident-related knowledge base articles, resolution guides, troubleshooting procedures, and known error workarounds in the Government's ITSM knowledge management system.
* Ensure Tier 1 and Tier 2 Service Desk personnel have access to current, accurate, and actionable knowledge base content to support first-contact resolution objectives, targeting at least 70% of eligible tickets resolved at Tier 1.
* Promote a knowledge-sharing culture across the NOC and Service Desk, ensuring resolution documentation is captured at ticket closure and that institutional knowledge is preserved throughout personnel transitions.

**Agile Delivery Integration:**  

* Participate in Sprint ceremonies as required, including Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, and Sprint Retrospectives, contributing incident management workstream priorities, improvement backlog items, and operational performance data to the Sprint cadence.
* Maintain and manage incident management-related backlog items in the Government's Agile/ITSM tooling, ensuring items are accurately prioritized, estimated, and tracked to completion each Sprint.
* Identify and propose process improvement opportunities for inclusion in the program backlog, driving measurable enhancements to incident management efficiency, SLA performance, and customer satisfaction.

**Security & Compliance:**  

* Ensure all incident management activities comply with applicable Federal security, privacy, and compliance requirements, including FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, SBA IT and cybersecurity policies, and CUI safeguarding requirements.
* Ensure suspected or confirmed security incidents are promptly identified, escalated, and reported in accordance with SBA incident response procedures and applicable Federal reporting requirements.
* Support the application of least-privilege, separation-of-duties, and Zero Trust principles within incident management workflows and access control practices.

**Education and Experience:****Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field from an accredited college or university. Equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT service management, with at least 3 years of dedicated experience in an Incident Manager, Major Incident Manager, or equivalent ITSM leadership role in an enterprise federal IT environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing the full incident lifecycle—including P1 major incident coordination—in a 24x7 enterprise IT operations environment of comparable scale and complexity.
* Demonstrated experience with ITIL-based ITSM practices, including incident management, problem management, change management, and knowledge management.
* Hands-on experience administering and managing incidents within an enterprise ITSM platform, preferably ServiceNow.
* Ability to obtain and maintain an SBA background investigation, HSPD-12 PIV credentials, and all required IT access authorizations prior to performing work requiring such access.

**Preferred:**  

* Prior experience supporting federal civilian agency IT operations programs.
* Experience supporting incident management within hybrid on-premises and cloud environments, including AWS and Microsoft Azure/365.
* Experience working within an Agile IT operations delivery model, integrating ITSM processes with Sprint-based planning and prioritization.

**Required Skills and Competencies:**  

* Exceptional communication skills in English—both written and oral—with the demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and concisely under time-critical conditions to diverse audiences including technical teams, program leadership, and senior Government stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead and coordinate cross-functional technical teams during high-pressure major incident events, driving rapid diagnosis and service restoration without direct authority over all participants.
* Deep knowledge of ITIL 4 incident management principles and practices, including incident classification, prioritization, escalation, SLA management, major incident management, and post-incident review processes.
* Hands-on proficiency with enterprise ITSM platforms, particularly ServiceNow, including incident workflow configuration, queue management, SLA monitoring, escalation rule management, and reporting.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify incident trends, recurring patterns, and systemic issues from ITSM data and translate findings into actionable improvement recommendations.
* Experience developing and maintaining incident management performance dashboards and metrics reports, including MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance rates, first-contact resolution rates, and incident volume trends.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain a high-quality knowledge base, ensuring Tier 1 and Tier 2 Service Desk personnel have access to current, accurate resolution guidance.
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure components relevant to incident management, including network, server, cloud (AWS/Azure), Microsoft 365, and enterprise application platforms.
* Familiarity with federal IT security and compliance requirements, including FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, Zero Trust Architecture principles, and CUI safeguarding requirements.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to simultaneously manage multiple open incidents at varying priority levels, maintaining accurate records and ensuring no incident falls through the cracks.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Teams, and enterprise collaboration tools.

**Desired Skills and Competencies:**  

* ITIL 4 Foundation certification or higher (e.g., ITIL 4 Specialist: High Velocity IT, ITIL 4 Managing Professional).
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) or ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) – IT Service Management.
* Experience managing incidents within AWS commercial and/or GovCloud environments, including familiarity with AWS monitoring, alerting, and event management tooling.
* Experience managing Microsoft 365 and Azure Government-related incidents, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and Microsoft Entra identity incidents.
* Familiarity with enterprise network incident management, including LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, routing, switching, wireless, and network security fabric incidents.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring and event management platforms (e.g., SolarWinds, Splunk, Dynatrace, or equivalent) as they relate to automated incident detection and correlation.
* Knowledge of problem management and root cause analysis methodologies, including Fishbone/Ishikawa analysis, 5 Whys, and Kepner-Tregoe problem analysis.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and experience participating in Sprint ceremonies within an IT operations context.
* Experience supporting post-incident review (PIR) facilitation and corrective action tracking programs in a federal IT environment.
* CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or equivalent cybersecurity certification demonstrating knowledge appropriate to managing incidents involving Federal IT systems and sensitive data.
* Experience with HSPD-12/PIV credentialing processes and federal identity and access management platforms, including Okta and Microsoft Entra.
* Familiarity with Section 508 compliance requirements as they apply to ITSM reporting tools and knowledge management platforms.
* Experience contributing to continual service improvement programs within an ITIL-aligned, Agile IT operations environment.

Title: Manager Data Center Operations
Description:
**Manager Data Center Operations**

**Your role**

The Manager Data Center Operationsis responsible for overseeing the execution of local data center operations at one or more data center properties. Data center operations include, but are not limited to:

* Engineering operations and core infrastructure maintenance
* Data center construction management, commissioning and start-up
* Delivery of data center services including colocation, connectivity, raised floor services and deployment
* Installation and management of all cable and network infrastructure supporting facility and customer connectivity
* Technical event management including post-event root cause analysis and infrastructure repair

**What you’ll do**

* Execute all aspects of data center operations including the operation, maintenance and repair of all mission critical equipment and systems supporting a 24x7 data center operation to achieve 100% uptime and 100% compliance with all customer SLAs.
* Supervises all construction activity and installations, in coordination with internal and external construction resources, to ensure system design, installation and testing adhere to operational standards.
* Witness testing of all equipment during commissioning and validate sequence of operations and receipt of all operational documentation.
* Manages provisioning of data center services including colocation, connectivity, raised floor services, deployment and any additional services to be delivered to data center customers.
* Manages all local customer installations, in coordination with Sales Engineering, Design & Construction and Colocation Operations to coordinate customer move-ins and turn-ups, including deployments, power circuit installations and connectivity requirements.
* Oversees local installation, maintenance and repair of all network infrastructure supporting all Digital Realty and customer connectivity in coordination with internal IT and network personnel.
* Supervise local engineering team to ensure adherence to standard operating procedures, sequence of operations and maintenance standards to guarantee execution of Digital Realty’s periodic maintenance program and maintenance calendar.

Title: Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
Description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is building some of the world's largest and most advanced GPU clusters to power the next generation of AI. The Strategic Customer Engineering (SCE) Core Infrastructure team—also known as the AI/ML Forward Deployed Infrastructure Engineering team—provides white-glove engineering and operational support to OCI's most strategic AI/ML infrastructure customers.

As a trusted partner to our customers, we play a critical role in designing, deploying, operating, and optimizing the infrastructure that powers some of the largest and most demanding GPU and AI/ML environments in the world. Our team works closely with customers and internal engineering organizations to ensure exceptional reliability, performance, and scalability for mission-critical AI workloads.

We are seeking a Manager to lead and develop a class of early-career Infrastructure Engineers. This leader will create the conditions for new professionals to build sound technical judgment, strong customer habits, and the practical skills required to support strategic AI/ML infrastructure customers on OCI. The manager will combine people leadership with hands-on operational guidance, helping the class grow into effective engineers who can independently contribute to customer execution, automation, troubleshooting, and infrastructure performance.

  

Lead, mentor, and develop a class of early-career Engineers, setting clear expectations for technical growth, customer engagement, quality, and ownership.

Design and run an onboarding and development program that gives early-career professionals progressive experience with GPU cluster deployment, Slurm and/or Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE), automation, monitoring, multicloud, database and operational readiness.

Provide regular coaching, feedback, career guidance, and practical learning opportunities. Pair team members with appropriate mentors and create stretch assignments that build confidence and sound engineering judgment.

Guide the team in building collaborative relationships with OCI Services, customers, sales, and core engineering teams. Model clear technical communication and help team members become effective, trusted customer partners.

Establish a safe, accountable environment where early-career professionals learn to take ownership of problems, investigate issues thoroughly, document risks, and escalate with context when needed.

Coach team members on infrastructure performance fundamentals, including parameter tuning, resource utilization, caching, and data pre-processing techniques for AI/ML workloads.

Oversee the team's approach to troubleshooting performance, scalability, and reliability issues. Review complex cases, remove barriers, and ensure lessons learned are incorporated into team practices.

Ensure the team documents infrastructure designs, configurations, runbooks, and procedures so knowledge is shared, work is maintainable, and new professionals can learn from repeatable practices.

Help team members develop into credible customer advocates who can explain advanced GPU solution best practices and support customers and partners as they migrate workloads to the cloud.

Partner with senior technical leaders to calibrate the class's development progress, staffing needs, and readiness for increasingly independent customer-facing and engineering responsibilities.

**Qualifications:**

7+ years of relevant infrastructure, cloud, platform, or software engineering experience, including experience leading or mentoring engineers.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to coach early-career professionals and translate technical concepts for customers, partners, and non-technical stakeholders.

Demonstrated people-management, mentoring, or talent-development skills, with a thoughtful and consistent approach to feedback and performance management.

Experience building, operating, or supporting distributed and cloud infrastructure solutions in a customer-focused environment.

Demonstrated ability to:

* Develop short-, medium-, and long-term development plans that connect individual growth to team and business objectives.
* Work across functional areas with senior leaders and technical partners to secure opportunities, support, and clear expectations for an early-career class.
Influence through coaching, sound judgment, and clear communication in situations involving competing priorities or sensitive feedback.  

BS or MS degree, or equivalent experience, relevant to the functional area.

Working knowledge of infrastructure automation and orchestration tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, Docker, Kubernetes, and related tooling.

Solid understanding of networking concepts, security principles, and operational best practices.

Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to guide others through structured troubleshooting and drive timely resolution in a fast-paced environment.

Strong Linux skills with hands-on experience in Oracle Linux/RHEL/CentOS, Ubuntu, or Debian, including system administration, package management, shell scripting, and performance optimization.

Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Rust, Go, Java, or Scala, and the ability to use code reviews and pairing to develop others.

Experience designing, implementing, managing, or supporting infrastructure for AI/ML, HPC, GPU, or similarly complex cloud workloads.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Planning & Execution:**

Plan and guide the class's work across onboarding, customer support, automation, and development goals. Set clear priorities, assign work that matches each person's readiness, monitor delivery, and adjust learning plans as business needs change.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

Build productive cross-functional partnerships that give early-career professionals access to the expertise and context they need. Model inclusive collaboration, actively seek diverse perspectives, and help the team communicate expectations clearly with stakeholders and customers.

**Problem Solving:**

Coach the team to analyze operational and technical issues using sound problem-solving practices. Review complex or ambiguous cases, help identify root causes, and turn lessons learned into guidance that prevents recurrence.

**Continuous Learning:**

Create structured opportunities for team members to build expertise through training, paired work, technical reviews, and hands-on customer scenarios. Track individual skill growth, identify gaps early, and reinforce a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous learning.

**Continuous Improvement:**

Enable the team to improve processes, protocols, runbooks, and workflows. Gather feedback from early-career professionals and partners, prioritize practical improvements, and help the team learn how to turn ideas into durable operational practices.

**Performance and Development:**

Drive consistent performance and development through timely, specific feedback, regular coaching, and clear growth expectations. Support hiring, onboarding, talent reviews, and promotion readiness in partnership with leadership and HR, while aligning individual development plans to organizational needs.

For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.
  
  
This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.
  
  
**About The Team And Role**
Customer Operations is the backbone of trust and reliability for readers, listeners, and creators across our products. We make sure every support interaction is handled with quality, consistency, and care, and we tailor how we support each of our customers.
  
  
As Senior Manager of Customer Operations, you'll shape the experience of millions of readers, listeners, and creators, especially in the moments when something goes wrong. You'll lead and develop the team that runs our day-to-day support operations across outsourced and in-house teams, so every customer gets support that is attentive, responsive, and tailored to what they need. You've helped build or scale a customer support organization before, and you know the fundamentals: how to balance cost and quality, how to manage outsourced/BPO relationships without losing visibility into the customer experience, and how to turn operational data into decisions. You lead through your team, not around them, and you're comfortable being accountable for outcomes you don't personally execute. You're also someone senior stakeholders like Legal, Product and Engineering trust to make a fast, sound call when something is sensitive or high-stakes.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Help build a world-class team that delivers high-touch, highly responsive support: set the service standard, hire and coach to it, and hold it consistently as the business grows
* Lead with a people-first approach: hire, develop, and empower the team, and shape team structure and career paths, so the team stays healthy and delivers great customer experiences
* Manage our BPO relationships, holding vendors accountable for performance standards and keeping cost and capacity on track against budget
* Lead workforce and capacity planning across in-house and BPO teams, including quarterly forecasts and staffing recommendations, working with data and analytics teams to turn operational data into decisions
* Manage our public reputation and reviews program (such as Trustpilot, Better Business Bureau, and app stores), turning customer sentiment into operational improvement
* Provide leadership on Trust & Compliance casework, including content moderation, DMCA, and privacy, guiding specialists and helping protect our platform and community while meeting our legal and regulatory obligations
* Partner with Legal and Trust teams to make sound, timely decisions on sensitive or high-stakes escalations, escalating to senior leadership when needed
* Collaborate with internal training and quality teams to keep standards, coaching, and agent readiness sharp as products and policies evolve
* Partner closely with the teams that own support tooling, automation/AI, and product to turn customer feedback into better tools and product decisions, and keep bug triage and escalation handoffs running smoothly
* Drive operational change and continuous improvement alongside the Customer Operations leadership team, introducing new tools, processes, and ways of working that make support better for customers and for the team

**What You Have**

* 8+ years in customer support or customer operations, including 5+ years in people leadership, managing both individual contributors and the leads who run a function
* Track record of leading through others: hiring and developing leads who each own a specialized area and are accountable for results
* Experience building a high-touch, customer-obsessed support team, with the judgment to tailor service to what different customers need
* Experience managing outsourced/BPO vendor relationships in a growing support organization, including performance management and cost accountability
* Strong command of support KPIs and the levers that move them (CSAT, resolution time, cost per contact, quality scores), plus experience with contact center operations and forecasting
* Comfort with data: able to build and analyze reports in a support platform like Zendesk, and work fluently in spreadsheet tools like Google Sheets
* A builder’s mindset, energized by designing and improving processes rather than just maintaining them

The ideal candidate blends strategic leadership, deep expertise in virtualization (VMware / VCF), and a track record of modernizing enterprise infrastructure environments.

Title: Network Systems Manager
Description:
The Network Systems Manager oversees the daily operational engineering, maintenance, management, and continuous optimization of the enterprise network infrastructure supporting the Air Force National Capital Region (AFNCR). This role ensures maximum network uptime, robust cybersecurity enforcement, and seamless mission-critical data transport across both unclassified (NIPR) and classified (SIPR/JWICS) secure enclaves
  
  
The Manager provides senior-level technical direction and leadership to a team of engineers and technicians, ensuring full alignment with Department of Defense (DoD) regulations and program objectives.
  
  
Since 1976, SMS has specialized in modernizing legacy IT and sustaining complex enterprise environments for federal agencies. With the goal of building long-term partnerships with our customers, we invest in our employees by providing the training, tools, and support they need to keep critical missions operational, improve performance, and reduce risk. SMS is headquartered in McLean, Virginia, with offices and on-site operations at customer locations throughout the United States. For additional information on SMS, visit www.sms.com.
  
  
Submit your resume today!
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Infrastructure Management: Oversee the configuration, deployment, optimization, and lifecycle management of core data center and enterprise LAN/WAN infrastructure, including Cisco Nexus and Catalyst switches, routers, F5 Load Balancers, and Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE).
* Operational Leadership: Manage a specialized team of network engineers and operations center specialists; coordinate shift logs, escalate tickets, and lead complex troubleshooting across physical, virtual, and transport layers.
* Security & Compliance: Enforce physical and logical cybersecurity measures in strict adherence to DoD regulations. Ensure network baselines maintain STIG compliance, support Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) remediation, and provide technical artifacts for RMF accreditation.
* Access Control & Crypto: Manage enterprise network systems utilizing Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco Catalyst Center for automated access control, device profiling, and policy enforcement. Support TACLANE/HAIPE encryptors (e.g., KG-175D) to secure sensitive data-in-transit.
* Performance Monitoring: Utilize telemetry and network monitoring tools (such as Cacti or other SNMP-based software) to closely track system capacity, application availability, and overall environmental health
* Documentation & Governance: Develop, enforce, and audit detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), network topology maps, rack layouts, and precise asset tracking databases
* Stakeholder Liaison: Serve as a primary technical contact for government stakeholders, Contracting Officer Representatives (CORs), and prime program leadership regarding network upgrades and configuration modifications.

**Required Qualifications**

* CCNA required, CCNP preferred
* Active DoD Secret security clearance
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field (Equivalent professional experience may be substituted on a 2-for-1 basis)
* Experience: Minimum of 8+ years of progressive experience in enterprise network engineering, network operations, or infrastructure support, with at least 2–3 years in a team lead, supervisory, or management capacity within a secure federal defense or intelligence environment.
* Network Access Control: Experience designing, implementing, operating, and maintaining IEEE 802.1X authentication and network access control solutions using Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), including integration with wired network infrastructure, identity sources, endpoint profiling, policy administration, and troubleshooting authentication and authorization issues.
* Application Delivery and Access Management: Experience configuring, administering, and troubleshooting F5 BIG-IP Load Balancers, including Local Traffic Manager (LTM) and Access Policy Manager (APM) modules. Experience should include virtual servers, pools, health monitors, traffic policies, SSL/TLS configuration, high availability, and access-policy configuration.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Demonstrate experience managing automated network configuration workflows and software-defined network spaces.
* Familiarity with deploying multicast-based platforms (such as IPTV architectures) across enterprise local area networks.
* Exceptional communication skills, with a proven track record of managing interdisciplinary cleared teams and translating complex technical details into executive-level briefs.

Title: Security Operations Team Lead
Description:
**Job Purpose**

The
**Security Operations Team Lead**
is a senior, hands-on cyber defence professional accountable for the operational effectiveness of the Group Security Operations Centre (SOC), leadership of two internal analysts, and governance of the Managed Security Services Provider (MSSP). The role requires a broad, practical command of blue-team security operations and deep specialist expertise in Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR). The incumbent must personally investigate complex cyber incidents from detection and evidence acquisition through containment, root-cause analysis, recovery validation and closure, rather than relying exclusively on external providers.

The role also leads the technical and operational delivery of the Group's phased transition from a traditional SOC to an AI enabled and, where justified, Agentic SOC under the strategy, investment approval and governance of the Information Security Manager. Each approved capability must show measurable security and productivity outcomes and a defensible return on investment (ROI), with secure operation and human accountability preserved.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Security Operations & Team Leadership**

* Lead, coach and manage two SOC analysts, overseeing daily priorities, technical development and high-severity investigations.
* Ensure effective 24/7 security monitoring, alert triage and escalation through the MSSP, maintaining oversight of incident queues, handovers and response SLAs.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident management across endpoints, networks, identity, email, cloud and critical business applications.

**Hands-on Cyber Defence & Incident Response**

* Perform hands-on security operations across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Windows/Linux, network and cloud security.
* Lead threat hunting, log analysis, detection engineering, alert investigation and security control validation using tools such as KQL and SPL.
* Act as the technical incident lead for major cybersecurity incidents, conducting digital forensics, evidence analysis, attack reconstruction, containment coordination and root-cause investigations.
* Develop and improve incident response playbooks, detection capabilities and defensive security controls.

**MSSP & Managed SOC Governance**

* Act as the primary operational liaison for the MSSP, overseeing service performance, monitoring effectiveness, escalation procedures and SLA compliance.
* Evaluate investigation quality, detection coverage and incident response, challenge findings where necessary and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Coordinate the MSSP with internal IT and security teams to continuously improve SOC operations.

**Threat Intelligence & Detection Engineering**

* Lead threat intelligence activities, including intelligence gathering, threat assessment, proactive threat hunting and identification of indicators of compromise.
* Improve SIEM monitoring through log-source management, detection rules, alert tuning, false-positive reduction and SOAR automation.

**AI-Enabled SOC Transformation**

* Lead the implementation of AI-assisted security operations and progressively introduce supervised agentic workflows to improve SOC efficiency.
* Develop and integrate AI-driven use cases for alert investigation, threat intelligence, event correlation, evidence collection and automated response workflows.
* Measure operational improvements, including analyst productivity, detection and response times, accuracy and cost savings, while ensuring appropriate security, governance and human oversight.

**Governance, Reporting & Stakeholder Management**

* Maintain SOC procedures, incident registers, escalation matrices, management dashboards and security reporting.
* Report on cybersecurity incidents, emerging threats, MSSP performance, security control effectiveness and SOC improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with IT, Legal, HR, Privacy, Internal Audit and business stakeholders on incident response, investigations, audit requirements and cybersecurity resilience.
* Ensure all investigations, evidence collection, containment activities and business-impacting changes follow approved access, authorisation and governance procedures.

**Key Requirements**

* ***Minimum eight years of relevant cybersecurity experience***
  , including substantial recent hands-on DFIR and blue-team work, incident leadership, and management of enterprise SOC or MDR/MSSP services.
* Proven personal ownership of complex investigations with forensic evidence acquisition, artifact analysis, attack reconstruction, chain of custody, technically defensible RCA and remediation validation.
* Broad practical security defence capability covering SIEM/SOAR, EDR/XDR, M365/Entra ID, endpoint, network, email, cloud and identity security; ability to independently validate MSSP conclusions.
* Hands-on scripting, APIs and security automation; practical experience using AI-enabled security tools or developing automated security workflows. Production agentic SOC delivery is an advantage, not a substitute for DFIR competence.
* Experience supervising analysts, working across multiple entities or a large enterprise, and reporting findings clearly to senior management.
* Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, IT, digital forensics or a related discipline, or substantial equivalent professional experience.
* Preferred: GIAC GCFA, GCFE, GCIH, GNFA or equivalent forensic/incident-response certification. CISSP, CISM and cloud/security automation credentials are beneficial. Practical competence takes precedence over certifications.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to prepare rigorous technical reports and concise executive-level assessments.

Title: Senior Program Manager - AI Infrastructure Services
Senior Manager - Incident Management
Description:
Lead incident and crisis management for the City Command Unit (CCU). Develop, maintain and assure the framework through which incidents across Qiddiya City are classified, escalated, commanded and resolved – from first report in the control room, through Bronze and Silver coordination, to Gold-level crisis activation – and act as the CCU’s senior incident lead during major incidents and crises. Ensure that incident response is consistent across assets, venues and partners, aligned with the Joint Security Operating Model and the Emergency Response Plan, accurately recorded, and followed by structured review, so that lessons are converted into better plans, procedures, training and decisions.

Responsabilities

* Lead the incident management function within the Crisis Operations sub-department of the City Command Unit, acting as the CCU’s subject-matter lead for incident and crisis management and providing professional direction on incident handling across the unit.
* Develop and maintain the incident management framework – incident classification and severity levels, the escalation matrix and thresholds, notification cascades and Gold–Silver–Bronze command roles – in line with the Joint Security Operating Model, the Emergency Response Plan and Incident Command System principles, for approval by the Director – Crisis Readiness.
* Act as the CCU’s senior incident lead at tactical (Silver) level during major incidents and crisis activations, as assigned under the command rota: establish command, set priorities, coordinate the response of Qiddiya’s operational functions and partners, and brief the Director – CCU and City Operations leadership.
* Assure live incident handling in the control room: support shift managers during significant incidents and ensure that the common operating picture, decision logs and situation reports are maintained and that escalation is timely and accurate.
* Manage the CCU’s crisis management arrangements – the crisis management room, support to the Gold-level crisis team, the crisis battle rhythm, information management and record keeping – so that the move from incident to crisis is controlled.
* Coordinate the multi-agency incident response interfaces with the Security Operations Centre, the contracted Fire and Rescue Service, medical response, Transport, the parks and venues and, through the CCU’s liaison arrangements, Civil Defence, Qiddiya Police and other public authorities, so that roles, primacy and handover are understood before and during incidents.
* Lead the post-incident process – hot debriefs, structured reviews, root-cause analysis and post-incident reports – and maintain the lessons and corrective-action register with named owners, target dates and closure evidence.
* Analyse incident data and trends, define incident-management performance indicators and report performance and emerging risks to the Director – Crisis Readiness and City Operations leadership, feeding the CCU risk register and readiness assessments.
* Build incident-command competence across the CCU and its partners: design and deliver training, coaching and assessment for shift managers, operators, duty managers and asset teams in incident command, decision-making, logging and briefing.
* Ensure incident response procedures, action cards and scenario playbooks are current and usable, working with the Senior Manager – Crisis Readiness and the Manager – Emergency Planning on their alignment with emergency plans and the exercise programme.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Emergency Management, Crisis and Disaster Management, Risk Management, Security Management, Public Safety or a closely related discipline. (Master’s degree or doctorate in a relevant field is desirable.).
* Recognised emergency- or crisis-management certification (such as Certified Emergency Manager, or training to ISO 22320 incident management and ISO 22361 crisis management) is desirable.
* Incident-command qualification (Incident Command System or Gold–Silver–Bronze tactical command training) or business-continuity certification (ISO 22301 or CBCI) is desirable.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in incident, emergency or crisis management, including at least 3 years in a senior role leading incident response or crisis management for a command centre, emergency service, major venue, critical infrastructure or city-scale operation.

* Experience in giga-project, theme-park, major-event, transport or government emergency-management environments is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience commanding or coordinating the response to major incidents at tactical (Silver) level or equivalent.
* Experience developing incident and crisis management frameworks, escalation arrangements and command structures, and embedding them across multiple operators and agencies.
* Experience supporting or advising a strategic (Gold) crisis management team during live crises and exercises.
* Experience leading post-incident reviews and converting lessons into tracked corrective actions.
* Experience working with civil-defence, police and emergency-medical authorities; Saudi Arabia or GCC experience is strongly preferred.

Title: Technology Infrastructure Manager
Description:
**Description**
**Summary**
Manages the County-wide technology infrastructure, including the enterprise network, server and storage environments, voice systems and building technology, as well as the public safety infrastructure that supports the Sheriff’s Office, the Jail and the multi-agency CAD/911 center. Supervises and develops the infrastructure and network operations staff of the Office of Information Technology. **Responsibilities**

Seeks and creates opportunities for improved performance, learning and development of staff and identifies and addresses problems or conflicts.
